summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by The Gorman-Rupp Company reporting results of its annual shareholder meeting held on April 23, 2026. Shareholders voted to fix the board at nine and elected all nine director nominees, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified Ernst & Young as independent auditor. No extraordinary transactions, activist campaigns, or strategic changes are disclosed. The only post-meeting action was the independent directors appointing Donald H. Bullock, Jr. as Lead Independent Director, a standard governance matter. This filing does not constitute a special situation; it is an ordinary current report of routine shareholder votes.
